about.en: XLF is the Financial Select Sector SPDR Fund (marketed as the State Street Financial Select Sector SPDR ETF), an exchange-traded fund sponsored by State Street Global Advisors that tracks the Financial Select Sector Index, representing banks, insurers, capital-markets and other financial companies within the S&P 500. Each share represents an interest in the fund's portfolio of US financial-sector equities. It is listed on NYSE Arca.
